# SafOil

> SafOil is a Malaysia-based supplier and exporter of waste- and residue-based biofuel feedstock for biodiesel (FAME), renewable diesel (HVO) and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) producers. Products include Used Cooking Oil (UCO), PFAD, POME oil, EFB oil, acid oils (soya, cottonseed, rice bran), SBEO, tallow and fish oil. Cargoes ship FOB from Malaysian ports or CIF to the buyer's discharge port, with a certificate of analysis (COA) per batch. Based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia (Reg. No. 20251026727).

Contact: sales@safoil.my · WhatsApp +60 16-229 8119 · Quote form: https://safoil.my/#quote

## Products

- [Biofuel feedstock overview](https://safoil.my/products/biofuel-feedstock-malaysia): all feedstocks SafOil supplies, with grades and shipping terms
- [Used Cooking Oil (UCO)](https://safoil.my/products/used-cooking-oil-malaysia): low-FFA UCO for biodiesel, HVO and SAF refiners; FOB and CIF
- [PFAD](https://safoil.my/products/pfad-supplier-malaysia): palm fatty acid distillate from Malaysian refineries
- [POME and EFB oil](https://safoil.my/products/palm-oil-residue-feedstock): palm residue oils used as advanced (Annex IX) feedstock
- [Acid oils and SBEO](https://safoil.my/products/acid-oil-supplier-malaysia): soya, cottonseed and rice bran acid oil; spent bleaching earth oil
